rules: Local models may cite these catalog IDs but may not invent vendors, SKUs, dimensions, ratings, availability, certifications, prices, or URLs.
ORDERABLE means an online product/order page was visible on the research date; it is not a stock guarantee.
DEALER_ORDER and SOLD_OUT remain procurement holds until availability is reconfirmed.
Engineering-hold hardware may be bought only for prototype testing, never treated as a released joint or vehicle restraint.
ots_class is an axis INDEPENDENT of status: status says whether you can buy it today, ots_class says whether it is off the shelf at all. An ENGINEERING_HOLD part can be OTS_STOCK, and frequently is.

ots_classes.OTS_STOCK: Buy the catalogue item as-is. Any field trimming is hand-tool trivial.
ots_classes.OTS_CUT: Catalogue item the vendor cuts to a length you specify as an ordering option.
ots_classes.OTS_MODIFIED: Catalogue item that needs drilling, tapping or machining after receipt.
ots_classes.CUSTOM_FLAT: Must be fabricated: a flat plate cut from sheet. The standing rule allows this.
ots_classes.CUSTOM_OTHER: Must be fabricated and is NOT a flat plate. Any part landing here is a design failure to escalate, not to accept.
